verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents some built-in AI capabilities. These include built-in LLM functions for text analysis and SQL generation, and Dives, which build dashboards from natural-language prompts and are refined conversationally ("add a filter for US region") with the Viewer updating in place. However, the evidence does not clearly show a general-purpose AI assistant inside the product that users delegate tasks to. Much of the conversational, agentic workflow is framed around external agents connecting through the MCP server rather than a native in-app assistant. Missing for 10: a documented in-product agent or chat assistant that accepts general task delegation, clarity on whether Dives conversation happens inside the MotherDuck UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
